title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Member Terms: Accepted Payments and Automatic Recharge
content:
**Term 1. Payment size.** A payment to a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) account is accepted only from the tier's smallest single payment through its largest single payment.

**Term 2. Payment channels.** On every tier the accepted channels are: online card, online electronic check, card through the phone payment line (IVR), payment kiosk, cash at an office, check at an office, and payment by an energy assistance agency.

**Term 3. Automatic recharge.** Automatic card recharge may be set up on every tier; each automatic recharge must be at least the tier's smallest automatic recharge amount.

| Tier | Smallest single payment (USD) | Largest single payment (USD) | Automatic recharge allowed | Smallest automatic recharge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | 10.00 | 500.00 | yes | 25.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 10.00 | 500.00 | yes | 25.00 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 10.00 | 500.00 | yes | 25.00 |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | 10.00 | 500.00 | yes | 25.00 |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | 10.00 | 500.00 | yes | 25.00 |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | 25.00 | 2000.00 | yes | 100.00 |

### Illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

- On PrePay Power Seasonal a payment of 10.00 or of 500.00 is within the terms; 9.99 and 500.01 are not.
- On PrePay Power Small Commercial a payment of 2000.00 is within the terms, and an automatic recharge of 99.99 is below the smallest automatic recharge of 100.00.
